title: Web: Setup, Exercises
description: GET /api/coach/setup/exercises. Every exercise in the synced Hevy history since `since` (16 weeks), alphabetically, as counting or not counted for weekly progression. POST /api/coach/setup/exercises/classify {exercise_id, classification: 'counts'|'excluded'} runs chat's classify_exercises; POST /api/coach/setup/exercises/pause {exercise_id, paused, reason?} runs chat's set_exercise_paused. Both return this view.

counts.description: Counts for weekly progression (false: excluded, still logged).

classified.description: false: not classified yet, so it counts by default.

paused.description: Logged but not judged (e.g. around an injury).
